Container.Name: MoviePoster
Container.Overview: Fullscreen Plex/Jellyfin movie poster display for a vertical TV (Raspberry Pi kiosk). Pulls poster art from your Plex or Jellyfin server and shows it as a shuffle-deck fullscreen slideshow with selectable transitions and a dynamic dominant-color background. Interrupts to show "Now Playing" with a progress bar when a chosen player is active. The Plex token / Jellyfin API key is proxied server-side and never exposed to the browser. Point a Raspberry Pi (or any kiosk browser) at http://[YOUR-UNRAID-IP]:3000. Open Settings by double-clicking the display, or browse to /settings directly.
Container.Description: Fullscreen Plex/Jellyfin poster display appliance. All state (settings, history DB, optional poster cache) is stored under /config so the container restores cleanly.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the poster display and settings page.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent storage: settings.json, history.db, and the poster cache.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (affects log timestamps and recency windows).
